name: model_interventions
built_by: hand-curated in experiment E2 (entry 150) from PubMed abstracts; PMID, title, year and journal columns filled from NCBI eutils esummary on 2026-09-24
method: Every published intervention (genetic or pharmacological) found in the Bub1b mouse genotypes that entry 150 ranks as the child's phenotype twins, plus two context rows (SIRT2 on a wild-type background; BubR1 overexpression) and three observational model rows that seed or caution a direction. Search: eutils esearch on PubMed, three queries (BubR1/Bub1b + hypomorphic mice + rescue/treatment; BubR1/Bub1b + senolytic/INK-ATTAC/p16/rapamycin/mTOR/NAD/SIRT2/nicotinamide/exercise; BubR1/Bub1b + mice + L1002P/MVA), 56 unique hits screened by title, 15 abstracts read with efetch. The phenotype rescued is quoted from the abstract; effect_size says 'not stated in abstract' where the abstract gives no number (full texts not read). twin_rank_* are the model genotype's pessimistic ranks among 76,699 MGI genotypes for the 8-term query (ressources/phenotype/phenotype_twin.json).

sources.clinical: child_hpo_link names the child's HPO terms (ressources/hackathon-rules/Challenge_Clinical_Phenotype_1.md) each rescued phenotype corresponds to
sources.genomic: none directly; the gene (BUB1B) comes from the Track 1 pair

inputs.name: PubMed esearch/esummary/efetch
inputs.licence: NCBI public; abstracts remain the publishers' copyright (quoted in paraphrase)

columns.direction: D3 = BubR1 stabilisation / raise BubR1 (mechanism.json); D5 = senolytic / mTOR (new in step 9); caution = a result that argues against a drug route; new (Wnt) = no existing direction
columns.supports_direction: supports / supports (mechanism only) / hypothesis only / limits / warns / context

assumptions: a rescue in BubR1 H/H mice is taken as evidence for the child's hypomorph only to the extent entry 150 ranks H/H as a twin; mouse lifespan and progeroid readouts are not paediatric endpoints
limitations: abstract-level only; no effect sizes; no drug in this table has been tested in a BubR1 model except NMN (raised BubR1 abundance, genotype not stated in the abstract)
